name: dissect
description: Reverse-engineer any video into a reusable blueprint for making similar videos.

plugins.name: dissect
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer any video (YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, X and more) into a frame-accurate blueprint: every cut and transition in frames, camera moves, type sizes, palette, beat grid and cues, transcript and voice, frame sheets, a timeline JSON and ready-to-paste build prompts. Then score your rebuild against it.
